description.content: A message in Novu represents a notification delivered to a recipient on a particular channel. Messages contain information about the request that triggered its delivery, a view of the data sent to the recipient, and a timeline of its lifecycle events. Learn more about messages.

List all messages for the current environment. 
    This API supports filtering by **channel**, **subscriberId**, and **transactionId**. 
    This API returns a paginated list of messages.
